I replied to Ilse in a thread on her message in #north-random. I confirmed the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is 10 June. That replaces the date she posted in #north-team this morning.

She said no action was needed, so I did nothing else. I did point out that her #north-team post still shows the old date, in case anyone there relies on it. A renewal date isn't a finance figure, so it's fine to discuss on the team's channels.
